Closed out the jsx-a11y/label-has-associated-control debt tracked since the 2026-08-17 entry below: all 362 warnings remaining at the time (9 had already been fixed piecemeal since the original 371) are now gone, -365 total (2106 -> 1741; a few of the -365 overlap with unrelated no-explicit-any noise churn from touched files, not all pure a11y). Every Label/control pair across all 55 affected files now has a real htmlFor/id association, generated from the label's own text (deterministic slugs, de-duplicated when a page repeats a label like "Plant"). Six shared components (PlantSelector, PlantPicker x2, ChemPlantPick, DesignationCombobox, DropZone in SmartImportPanel.tsx) gained or already had an optional `id` prop threaded through to their real trigger/input element. A double handful of cases were genuine false positives or non-control labels rather than missing associations, and were fixed accordingly rather than forced into htmlFor pairs: (1) Radix Switch/Checkbox render as button[role=switch|checkbox], not a native input, so a label correctly wrapping one (the standard WAI-ARIA pattern, with its own aria-label or visible wrapped text as the accessible name) still trips this rule -- documented with a one-line eslint-disable-next-line at each of the ~10 spots, same justification every time; (2) several Labels were section/group headers sitting above a set of buttons, a list of already-individually-labeled fields, or a whole sub-component ("Identity", "GPS Coordinates", "Role & access", "Booster Pump Targets", the AFM/booster-pump/filter-housing grids in EditPretreatReadingDialog.tsx) rather than one control -- swapped to plain

Added jsx-a11y/label-has-associated-control (see eslint.config.js), scoped to this one rule rather than jsx-a11y's full recommended config. Configured settings['jsx-a11y'].components = { Label: 'label' } so the rule actually sees the ~430 uses of the shadcn <Label> wrapper (src/components/ui/label.tsx -> @radix-ui/react-label -> a real <label>), not just the 46 native <label> tags -- without that mapping the rule silently passes and catches almost nothing. This surfaces 371 pre-existing warnings, all in forms where a visible Label sits next to an Input/control with no htmlFor/id pairing, so most fields in this app were reaching screen readers as an unnamed 'edit text' with no announced purpose. Auth.tsx (sign-in, forgot-password, OTP reset, and all sign-up steps -- the very first screen every user touches) is fixed as of this same change and contributes 0 of the 371; DesignationCombobox.tsx gained an optional `id` prop (forwarded to its trigger button, with an aria-label fallback when unset) so every call site of that shared combobox can be labeled the same way. Remaining 371 is tracked the same way no-explicit-any already is: a shrinking budget, not a license to add more. Worst offenders for a follow-up pass: PretreatmentAndROLog.tsx (57), WellDialogs.tsx (37), LocatorDialogs.tsx (31), Costs.tsx (20).

DataAnalysis.tsx: exported runOLS/getResetThreshold/getZThreshold/median/RawReading/CorrectionRow so the regression-correction workflow could be unit tested (see DataAnalysis.test.ts). +4 react-refresh/only-export-components warnings, same accepted trade-off already present in Compliance.tsx for the same reason.

Moved runOLS and friends out of DataAnalysis.tsx into lib/regressionCorrection.ts (a plain .ts file, no JSX). react-refresh/only-export-components only fires on files exporting React components, so the 4 warnings from the previous entry disappeared entirely rather than needing to be carried indefinitely -- the extraction is a strictly better fix than accepting the trade-off in place.

ProductSection.tsx: wired ProductMeterHistoryDialog to the shared CorrectionReasonField/logReadingEdit pattern -- product meter edits were the one reading-edit surface missing a required correction reason and an audit-log entry (well/locator/power/blending/RO train/pretreatment/CIP/dosing already had both). DataCorrections.tsx: fetchPending() now joins reading_anomaly_remarks per pending row so the operator's own entry-time remark shows on each Pending Review card. +7 no-explicit-any warnings from the new supabase `.from(... as any)` calls and logReadingEdit payloads, same convention already used throughout these files.

Reconciling drift accumulated across the weekly-granularity work (M1-M4 of pwri-improvement-plan.md) plus this pass's own changes -- CI has been red since before this pass started. Two parts: (1) buildEntityPivot-fix-rebased.patch, ro_pretreat_delete_rls_fix.sql, and reconciled-weekly-granularity.patch (the three commits after this file's previous 1627 entry) were never accompanied by a ceiling update -- actual was already 1635 as of the commit this file still claimed 1627 for, rising to 1640 by the most recent of the three. Not re-litigated here; treated as inherited baseline. TDS/Recovery's by-train view is the one chart from the plan still on daily-only lines with no Weekly/Monthly/stacking/drill -- left for a follow-up pass rather than rushed in here.

Inherited drift, not re-litigated (same situation as the entry above): hamas-production-fix.patch (55e95f8) added a directMeterIds set to DataSummaryModal.tsx/TrendChart.tsx/TrendChartDataSummaryPopup.tsx/Dashboard.tsx -- the same 'is_derived meter as direct-volume' fix that had also been prepared independently on this end -- but its own +16 no-explicit-any warnings (from the new supabase `.from(product_meters as any)` filter/map callbacks building that set, same convention already used for directLocatorIds) were never folded into this file. pwri-dashboard-fixes.patch, sibling-locators-stacked-chart.patch, and hamas-mambaling-same-day-sweep.patch (the three commits after it) added none of their own. Fixing a regression, not adding one -- net -6. trendchart-weekly-granularity-1.patch (4e3c952) was applied from what looks like a branch that forked before the 1641 entry above landed: it overwrote TrendChartDrill.tsx back to its pre-split, monolithic form (byte-identical to the commit before that split), silently orphaning TrendChartDrillKit.ts (0 importers afterward) and bringing back the 7 react-refresh/only-export-components warnings that split had removed -- the 1657 entry above inherited this without diagnosing it. Guizo train-permeate wiring (20260813_secondary_ro_train_wiring.sql: ro_trains.unit_type/feed_source_train_id/reject_routing, for Potable-RO/Refilling-RO as secondary 2nd-pass units whose reject recirculates into Train 1's permeate). This pass's own change, the double-count guard for the two headline production numbers: a secondary unit's permeate is the same water its upstream primary train already counted once, so it must never be summed again into Production/NRW%.
